# hypbr

> Hybrid Neural + Exact Periodic Procedural PBR Material Synthesizer that outputs seamlessly tileable, physically calibrated 15-map PBR texture sets (glTF 2.0 ORM, 16-bit height, OpenGL/DirectX tangent normals, 8-azimuth HBAO, bent normals, curvature, anisotropy, specular, and thickness) for a 500-material agent-ready atlas. Hosted atlas for agents (no install): https://hypbr.vercel.app/llms.txt

## Install

- `pip install -e .` (core procedural synthesis, blend, weather, export, verify: `numpy`, `pillow` only — no torch)
- `pip install -e ".[gpu]"` (optional `torch` for CUDA/MPS-accelerated procedural kernels; identical output on CPU)
- `pip install -e ".[neural]"` (optional photo-to-PBR via torch + ONNX Runtime + Apple Depth Pro)
- Env: `HYPBR_TORCH=0` forces the NumPy path; `HYPBR_DEVICE=cpu|mps|cuda` selects the torch device. `hypbr.has_torch()` reports availability.

## Performance & Environment

- CPU synthesis of one material: about 1 s at 512px and about 11-13 s at 2048px (4 threads). Output is deterministic for a given material ID, size and seed.
- `HYPBR_DEVICE=cpu|mps|cuda`: torch device for blur/HBAO/preview kernels (default: best available).
- `HYPBR_THREADS=N`: threads for row-parallel NumPy kernels (Worley cells, studio preview); default `min(4, cpu_count)`, `1` disables. Output is identical for any value.

## CLI Commands

- `hypbr list` — List all 500 built-in atlas material IDs and categories.
- `hypbr atlas search "<query>" [--category ...] [--limit 20]` / `hypbr atlas recommend <object> [--style ...] [--environment interior|exterior]` / `hypbr atlas info <material_id> [--snippet threejs|blender]` — Query the atlas (ranked search, per-object recommendations with UV repeat & weathering advice, full spec card).
- `hypbr atlas export <site_dir>` — Write `llms.txt`, `agent.md`, `atlas.json` and `atlas/` JSON shards. `hypbr atlas calibrate --refs <scan dirs> --baked <uncalibrated bake>` refits the reference-photo calibration.
- `hypbr synth <material_id|all> --size 512 --out ./output/pbr [--seed 42] [--wear 0..1] [--weather-preset aged|rain|mossy|rusty|dusty|coastal|abandoned] [--dirt|--wet|--moss|--rust|--dust 0..1] [--export unity,godot,unreal,blender,threejs,gltf,glb,vulkan,materialx,usd|all]` — Synthesize a complete 15-map seamless PBR material set with optional multi-layer weathering and engine export (`hardops_plate` is also accepted).
- `hypbr weather <material_dir> --out <out_dir> [--preset ...] [--wear|--dirt|--wet|--moss|--rust|--dust 0..1] [--kind metal|copper|brick|stone|wood|...] [--seed 42] [--backend procedural|neural --patch-dir <dir>] [--export ...]` — Weather an existing material directory; also writes `weather_mask.png` (`R=Wear, G=Dirt/Rust, B=Wet, A=Moss`).
- `hypbr blend <dir_a> <dir_b> --out <out_dir> [--mode height|cavity|linear] [--factor 0.5] [--contrast 0.06]` — Physically blend two `hypbr` materials via 16-bit HeightLerp/cavity masking with linear-light albedo and recomputed HBAO/curvature/ORM.
- `hypbr preview <material_dir> [--host 127.0.0.1] [--port 8765] [--no-open]` — Launch a zero-dependency local Three.js PBR material inspector in the browser.
- `hypbr export <src_dir> --target <unity|unity-hdrp|godot|unreal|blender|threejs|gltf|glb|vulkan|materialx|usd|all> --out <out_dir>` — Export an existing `hypbr` material directory with engine-native channel packing, normal convention, and material definition files.
- `hypbr verify <material_dir> [--json] [--seam-limit 2.2]` — Automated physical calibration, ORM consistency, normal validity, and wrap-around seamlessness QA check (CI exit code 0/1).
- `hypbr dump-preset [v13-default]` — Export a built-in composable PBR node graph preset as JSON.
- `hypbr photo <image> --preset v13-default [--graph custom.json] [--tileable] [--dx] --out ./output/photo_pbr` — Convert a macro photograph into 15 PBR maps using Apple Depth Pro + DeepBump ONNX + the 47-node graph.

## Python API

Signatures below are checked against the code by `tests/test_docs.py`.

### Synthesis
- `synthesize_material(material_id, out_dir, size=512, seed=None, wear=0.0, *, weather_preset=None, dirt=None, wet=None, moss=None, rust=None, dust=None, calibrated=True) -> Path`: Writes 15 seamless PBR PNGs + `preview.png` (+ `weather_mask.png` when weathered) to `out_dir`. `calibrated=False` reproduces the uncalibrated output.
- `synthesize_all(out_dir, size=512, materials=None, wear=0.0, *, weather_preset=None, dirt=None, wet=None, moss=None, rust=None, dust=None) -> list[Path]`: Batch-synthesizes all or selected materials.
- `synthesize_hardops_plate(out_dir, size=512) -> Path`: Machined hard-surface gunmetal panel (SDF plugs, bevels, weld fillets).

### In-memory maps (no PNG round-trips)
- `synthesize_material_maps(material_id, size=512, seed=None, wear=0.0, *, weather_preset=None, dirt=None, wet=None, moss=None, rust=None, dust=None, calibrated=True, preview=True) -> MaterialMaps`: Same synthesis as `synthesize_material`, kept in memory; `synthesize_material` is `synthesize_material_maps(...).save(out_dir)`.
- `synthesize_hardops_plate_maps(size=512, *, preview=True) -> MaterialMaps`: In-memory hard-surface panel.
- `MaterialMaps`: dataclass of float32 arrays — `albedo` (H,W,3 linear light), `normal`/`bent_normal` (H,W,3 unit, OpenGL +Y), `height`, `roughness`, `metallic`, `ao`, `curvature` (0.5 = flat), `cavity`, `edge_wear`, `anisotropy` (H,W,3 as saved), `specular`, `thickness`; optional `preview` (uint8 sRGB), `weather_mask` (H,W,4), `blend_mask`; `extras`, `metadata` (`material_id`, `seed`, `kind`, `calibrated`, `weather`, ...). `.save(dir, write_metadata=False) -> Path` writes byte-identical files to `synthesize_material`; `MaterialMaps.load(dir)` round-trips losslessly; `.encode("normal.png")` gives the exact 8/16-bit array; also `.file_names()`, `.orm`, `.copy()`.
- `blend_materials_maps(mat_a, mat_b, factor=0.5, contrast=0.06, mode="height", *, preview=True) -> MaterialMaps` and `weather_material_maps(src, *, preset=None, wear=None, dirt=None, wet=None, moss=None, rust=None, dust=None, material_kind=None, seed=42, backend="procedural", patch_dir=None, vit_patch=None, preview=True) -> MaterialMaps`: Chain blending/weathering in memory. Inputs are read at saved 8/16-bit precision, so results equal the directory path exactly.
- Every material argument of `blend_materials`, `weather_material`, `export_material` and `verify_material` accepts a directory or a `MaterialMaps`.
- `has_torch() -> bool`: Whether PyTorch is importable. Procedural synthesis, blend, weather, export and verify need only numpy + pillow; torch (`pip install "hypbr[gpu]"`) adds CUDA/MPS kernels with identical CPU output, `hypbr photo` needs `hypbr[neural]`. `HYPBR_TORCH=0` forces the NumPy path.
- `list_materials() -> list[dict]`: `{id, name, description, category, atlas_category, subcategory, generator}` for all 500 materials.

### Atlas (agent metadata)
- `search_atlas(query=None, category=None, object_type=None, scene_role=None, metallic=None, max_roughness=None, limit=20, base_url=...) -> list[dict]`: Ranked search over names, tags, objects and roles with physical filters.
- `recommend_for_object(object_name, style=None, environment=None, limit=5, surface_size_m=None, base_url=...) -> dict`: Materials for an object with UV repeat and environment-adjusted weathering.
- `get_material_spec(material_id, base_url=..., surface_m=None) -> dict`: Full spec card (`real_world_size_m`, `projection`, `shader_setup`, `recommended_weathering`, `pairs_well_with`, texture URLs, Three.js / Blender / glTF snippets).
- `get_atlas(base_url=...) -> dict` / `export_atlas_files(out_dir, base_url=..., measurements=None) -> dict`: Manifest, and static site export.

### Weathering, blending, export, QA
- `weather_material(src_dir, out_dir, *, preset=None, wear=None, dirt=None, wet=None, moss=None, rust=None, dust=None, material_kind=None, seed=42, backend="procedural", patch_dir=None, vit_patch=None) -> Path`: Weathers an existing material directory (or `MaterialMaps`). `WEATHER_PRESETS` holds the named presets (`abandoned, aged, coastal, dusty, mossy, rain, rusty`).
- `resolve_weather_params(preset=None, *, wear=None, dirt=None, wet=None, moss=None, rust=None, dust=None) -> dict`, `compute_weathering_masks(...)`, `apply_weathering_maps(...)`, `infer_material_kind(name, met_mean=0.0)`: Lower-level in-memory weathering building blocks.
- `blend_materials(dir_a, dir_b, out_dir, factor=0.5, contrast=0.06, mode="height") -> Path`: Physically blends two seamless material directories using 16-bit height-lerp, cavity, or linear masking with linear-light albedo and recomputed HBAO/bent-normal/curvature/ORM.
- `export_material(src_dir, out_dir, target, name=None) -> Path`: Converts a synthesized `hypbr` directory to engine-native assets:
  - `unity`: URP `MetallicSmoothness.png` (`R=Metallic, A=1-Roughness`), OpenGL `+Y` normal, `unity_material.json`.
  - `unity-hdrp`: HDRP `MaskMap.png` (`R=Metallic, G=AO, B=Detail, A=1-Roughness`), OpenGL `+Y` normal.
  - `godot`: Godot 4 `material.tres` (`StandardMaterial3D` with ORM channels + deep parallax) + textures.
  - `unreal`: DirectX `-Y` flipped `T_Normal_DX.png` & `T_BentNormal_DX.png`, `T_ORM.png`, `T_Height16.png`, `ue5_material.json`.
  - `blender`: Blender 4.x `import_blender.py` (Principled BSDF node tree with `sRGB`/`Non-Color` setup) + textures.
  - `threejs`: ES module `material.js` (`MeshPhysicalMaterial` factory) + textures.
  - `gltf`: glTF 2.0 `material.gltf` + `baseColor.png`, `orm.png`, `normal.png`.
  - `glb`: Single self-contained binary `<name>.glb` preview sphere with embedded albedo, ORM, and normal maps.
  - `vulkan`: `vulkan_manifest.json` (`VK_FORMAT_*` + `ktx create` commands), `orm_unorm.png`, `normal_rg_bc5_src.png`, `height_r16.png`.
  - `materialx`: MaterialX 1.38 `material.mtlx` (`standard_surface` + `displacement`) + textures.
  - `usd`: OpenUSD ASCII `material.usda` (`UsdPreviewSurface` with normal scale/bias decoding) + textures.
- `verify_material(mat_dir, seam_ratio_limit=2.2) -> dict`: Pass/fail report with border-to-interior seam ratios, normal unit-length/+Z/curl metrics, ORM channel diff, and PBR luminance/roughness ranges.
- `render_preview_html(material_name)` / `serve_preview(mat_dir, host="127.0.0.1", port=8765, open_browser=True)`: Local Three.js studio preview.

### Graph & neural
- `PRESETS: dict[str, dict]` and `run_graph(graph_spec, sources, circular=False)`: Built-in JSON-serializable PBR node graphs (default: `"v13-default"`) and their executor.
- `apply_depthpro_weightcode(model, ...)` / `spectral_filter_3x3_kernel(W, dc_gain, ramp_gain, detail_gain)` / `tileable_4quad_blend(rgb, infer_fn)`: Zero-training analytic weight surgery on 3×3 Conv2d kernels and exact 4-quadrant partition-of-unity seamless blending (photo mode; torch-only, resolved lazily from `hypbr`).

## Output Maps (per material)

- `albedo_delit.png`: 8-bit sRGB de-lit base color
- `normal.png`: 8-bit RGB tangent-space normal (OpenGL +Y; pass `--dx` in `photo` mode for DirectX -Y)
- `bent_normal.png`: 8-bit RGB average unoccluded hemisphere direction
- `height.png`, `height16.png`: 8-bit and 16-bit linear POM/displacement heightmaps
- `ao.png`: 8-bit 8-azimuth Horizon-Based Ambient Occlusion
- `roughness.png`: 8-bit roughness with Kaplanyan/Toksvig Specular AA
- `metallic.png`: 8-bit metallic mask
- `orm.png`: 8-bit glTF 2.0 packed ORM (`R=AO, G=Roughness, B=Metallic`)
- `curvature.png`, `cavity.png`, `edge_wear.png`: Multi-scale curvature, crevice, and convex wear masks
- `anisotropy.png`, `specular.png`, `thickness.png`: Anisotropic tangent flow, F0 specular modulation, subsurface thickness
- `preview.png`: Shaded studio preview

## Core Modules

- [hypbr/atlas.py](hypbr/atlas.py): Atlas search, per-object recommendation, spec cards, engine snippets and static site export (`hypbr atlas`).
- [hypbr/atlas_catalog.py](hypbr/atlas_catalog.py) / [hypbr/atlas_generators.py](hypbr/atlas_generators.py) / [hypbr/atlas_detail.py](hypbr/atlas_detail.py): 500-material catalog metadata, 28 periodic parametric generator families, and the seamless micro-detail / ground-cover pass.
- [hypbr/calibration.py](hypbr/calibration.py): Reference-photo calibration (periodic FFT band equalizers for albedo contrast, relief and roughness) and its closed-loop fitter.
- [hypbr/weathering.py](hypbr/weathering.py): Procedural (and optional neural) 6-channel physical weathering (`hypbr weather`).
- [hypbr/color.py](hypbr/color.py): Exact sRGB transfer functions used for every albedo read/write.
- [hypbr/weightcode.py](hypbr/weightcode.py): Zero-training analytic 3×3 spectral kernel surgery, SVD energy shrinkage, circular padding, and 4-quadrant tileable blending.
- [hypbr/blend.py](hypbr/blend.py): 16-bit HeightLerp / cavity physical material blending (`hypbr blend`).
- [hypbr/preview.py](hypbr/preview.py): Zero-dependency local interactive Three.js PBR studio preview (`hypbr preview`).
- [hypbr/verify.py](hypbr/verify.py): Automated seamlessness, normal validity, ORM packing, and PBR calibration verifier (`hypbr verify`).
- [hypbr/exporters.py](hypbr/exporters.py): Engine & standard I/O exporters (`unity`, `unity-hdrp`, `godot`, `unreal`, `blender`, `threejs`, `gltf`, `glb`, `vulkan`, `materialx`, `usd`).
- [hypbr/cli.py](hypbr/cli.py): Command-line entrypoint (`hypbr`).
- [hypbr/synthesize.py](hypbr/synthesize.py): Public Python synthesis API and multi-tone physical albedo/metallic rules.
- [hypbr/maps.py](hypbr/maps.py): `MaterialMaps` in-memory material with byte-exact `.save()` / `.load()`.
- [hypbr/_backend.py](hypbr/_backend.py): Optional-torch backend with NumPy fallbacks for the procedural kernels.
- [hypbr/procedural.py](hypbr/procedural.py): Exact periodic FBM, Voronoi, weave, ceramic, wood, and metal heightfield generators.
- [hypbr/normal_graph.py](hypbr/normal_graph.py): 47-node composable PBR graph engine (RNM blending, Weickert structure tensor, analytic bevels, 8-azimuth HBAO, Specular AA).
- [hypbr/depthpro_pbr.py](hypbr/depthpro_pbr.py): Optional Apple Depth Pro + DeepBump ONNX neural relief extractor with 4-rotation perspective cancellation.

## Examples & Tests

- [examples/synthesize_pbr.py](examples/synthesize_pbr.py): Synthesize sample 15-map PBR materials via Python API.
- [examples/custom_graph.py](examples/custom_graph.py): Inspect and export an editable 47-node JSON graph.
- [tests/test_smoke.py](tests/test_smoke.py): Smoke tests verifying catalog, presets, and 15-map output integrity.
